reports.title: Cancellation takes several screens
reports.description: The cancellation route is difficult to locate and requires several confirmation screens. The user is repeatedly prompted to keep the subscription.
reports.reviewerNote: The submitted journey shows repeated retention prompts. Published as a documented user experience, not a legal finding.

reports.title: Add-on appears preselected at checkout
reports.description: An optional protection add-on appeared selected by default during checkout. The selection was not obvious in the order summary.

reports.title: Repeated prompts after declining trial
reports.description: The app repeatedly displays prompts to start a free trial after the user chooses to continue with the free version.

reports.title: Renewal price is hard to notice
reports.description: The renewal amount is visually less prominent than the introductory offer. More evidence is needed to understand the full journey.
reports.reviewerNote: Request a screenshot of the final confirmation step.

responses.message: We are reviewing the cancellation flow and will provide an update.
